origine_fr: L'homme 亻 et 寺, qui devait donner le son : se tenir au service. 寺 se lit sì, pas shì : ses morceaux sont ici des formes. La personne qui sert : 侍者, le serviteur.
origine_en: A person 亻 and 寺, which was meant for the sound: to stand in service. 寺 is read sì, not shì, so its parts are just shapes here. The one who serves: 侍者, an attendant.

mots.en: to attend to, to wait on

phrase.zh: 她每天服侍生病的母亲。
phrase.pinyin: Tā měi tiān fúshi shēngbìng de mǔqin.
phrase.fr: Chaque jour, elle soigne sa mère malade.
phrase.en: Every day she looks after her sick mother.
